authorization_gates: R4 code-only tester PASS and R4 scope-only decision

workflow_behavior.output: allowlisted aggregate-only JSON report plus hash-pinned receipt; unexpected report schema fails closed

execution_authorization_contract.missing_or_pending_approval: safe no-op before any artifact cache restore/download
execution_authorization_contract.stale_or_mismatched_approval: fail closed before any artifact cache restore/download
execution_authorization_contract.reruns: blocked by GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT and permanent consumed-nonce ledger

Verify only encrypted Greek source is cached; temporary logs/diagnostic worktree are deleted; no source ZIP or decrypted table is uploaded

Verify the separate execution authorization request is required and its exact blob hash is included in the final tester authorization
